witness.branch: Nighttime parking with another vehicle present
witness.quote: between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.
witness.reason: Parking a qualifying carriage near another vehicle is compatible with the nighttime restriction.
required_context: Establish carriage transport capability, absence of self-propulsion and absence of vehicle-definition exclusions independently of the actor name.
Establish parking rather than actual temporary loading or unloading, with civil date, time zone and episode timing.
Establish qualifying vehicle and nonmotor status independently of the actor identifier.
Establish responsible person, qualifying street, municipal jurisdiction, parking purpose and actual loading or unloading activity.
Establish street boundaries, public access, municipal jurisdiction and responsible person.
Preserve unresolved definition applicability, NRS 482.029 reference and nighttime boundary-counting questions.
Realize both vehicles' geometry and states; do not assume double parking or a curbside stationary other vehicle.
Record civil date, time zone and complete parking boundaries and duration.
Specify both vehicles' dimensions, positions, routes and states without assuming the other vehicle is parked at the curb.
witness.subject_reason: The available horse_drawn_vehicle_operator can be the person parking the qualifying carriage.
